sentences.text: GNPTG-mucolipidosis is linked to the gene GNPTG in curated databases [e_defc8600f133].

Constellate computed that the two diseases look somewhat alike, with a score of 0.218 that is inferred and not a diagnosis [e_45810198c84c].

Coarse facial features and intellectual disability are marked as contradicted for this disease, with 1 contradicting record each [e_b9d1b7fd988c] [e_e0896f6d7a10].
For mucopolysaccharidosis type 4, one recruiting study of body function and one completed newborn screening study are listed [e_1fcff86aef59] [e_7f28d7b0cdcb].
